description: Environment and Climate Change Canada publishes CanLEADv1, bias-adjusted daily climate ensembles for North America on a half-degree grid. NetCDF files contain temperature, precipitation, humidity, pressure, wind and radiation. Fifty-member CanESM2 and CanRCM4 ensembles are adjusted against two observational forcing datasets. Historical and RCP8.5 simulations cover 1950–2100; natural-forcing-only CanESM2 simulations cover 1950–2020. The public portal links the file service, and use is free under the Open Government Licence Canada. These multivariate inputs support hydrological impact, energy-demand and event-attribution simulations and complement data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds. Bias adjustment preserves the modelled change signal outside its calibration period. The ensemble primarily samples initial-condition variability, not the full uncertainty across climate models. Grid-scale values cannot represent individual drainage catchments or local wind loads without further checking and downscaling.
